text: Remote team handoffs are a constant tug-of-war between convenience and control. When we prioritize speed—sending a quick Slack or a vague Loom video—we risk losing vital context and triggering costly rework later. However, over-indexing on control through exhaustive documentation and mandatory syncs can create bottlenecks that kill creative momentum. The challenge isn't choosing one side over the other, but finding the precise point where information flows freely enough to maintain velocity without losing its quality.
